scope: Bounded read-only static comparison of two DLL files in the official Git repository at exact commits. No DLL loaded/executed; no EXE downloaded. Does not verify the contents of a complete installer ZIP, the user installation, or the modules loaded in any user match.
classification: Both sampled repository versions contain the previously identified runtime code-integrity and selected game-data-integrity mechanisms. Their filename does not distinguish ordinary from hardened behavior. They are distinct binaries; neither is identical to either previously analyzedv0.0.0.17 DLL.

proof.crc_address_form: Verifier and baseline read data constant0xFFBFEFFF and complement it to0x401000; CRC table pointer resolves to0x81F7B4. This different encoding explains absent immediate0x401000 references; it does not remove the scan.
proof.house_check_qualification: Observed CurrentPlayer snapshot comparison and the additional CurrentFrame>100, CurrentPlayer==Observer, !Defeated conditional match the earlier analyzed behavior.

verified_behaviors.control_predicate: 50B6F0 patch initializer targets the listed helper. Non-Campaign returns whether the tested House pointer equals CurrentPlayer; Campaign retains IsHumanPlayer/IsInPlayerControl behavior.
verified_behaviors.runtime_code_crc: Relevant patch descriptors were joined to their CRT initializers and actual targets. Baseline writes CRCs of248*16KiB from0x401000; verifier in Session modes3/4 cycles through one block and compares its CRC against the stored baseline. Extent is[0x401000,0x7E1000).
verified_behaviors.baseline_reachability: The683E94 helper calls the baseline then reproduces the success epilogue; the67E6E0 helper tail-calls the same baseline after its completion work.
verified_behaviors.selected_data_checks: Data-verification body compares BuildingType offsets0xEB4,0x170C,0x157A against snapshots and contains CurrentPlayer/observer checks. Resolved static pointers identify Session=A8B238, CurrentPlayer=A83D4C and Observer=AC1198.
verified_behaviors.failure_path: Three data-check callers and one code-CRC mismatch caller directly call the listed fatal function. Its shape resets/combines register markers, clearsEDI, copies it toEBP and jumps toEBP=0. This is not a normal return or a demonstrated FRAMEINFO synchronization-error dialog.

proof.house_check_qualification: CurrentPlayer/observer checks are present, but an additional DLL boolean gate can skip this group. That flag meaning was intentionally not traced; do not claim all conditions identical to stable orv17.

limits: No claim that the user currently runs either sampled DLL.
No substitution of a develop-branch sample for the stable-tag sample.
No full reverse engineering of either package DLL or every added mechanism.
No inference from file size or changedRVA alone; classification uses descriptors, initializer-to-target linkage, inspected control flow, resolved data pointers and failure-path cross-references.
No bypass instructions or executable modifications.
